subject: Orion Health - audit log transport, encryption & bulk extract
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orionhealth.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFI: Audit logs — transport encryption, tamper evidence, bulk extract options

Jordan / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our procurement RFI for the Orion clinical platform integration, our security and legal teams need details on how Redwood handles audit logs and evidence exports. Key items we need clarified:

- In-transit encryption for bulk exports (TLS versions supported, client certs, mTLS)
- At-rest encryption for exported bundles and whether keys are customer-managed (KMS/HSM)
- Tamper-evidence: hashing or signatures applied to exported bundles and how chain-of-custody is preserved
- Supported delivery patterns: S3 push, presigned URLs, SFTP, streaming (Kafka) and max export file size
- Retention window controls and whether we can request point-in-time snapshots (and the SLA for producing those)
- File formats/schema (audit fields, event IDs, timestamps, UUIDs) — please see attached CSV stub of the fields we expect.

We are on a tight timeline — can you confirm these details and whether you can provide a sample export package and a proposed delivery SLA? Our legal ops may follow up with a DPA/contract request.

Appreciate a response by EOD Tuesday PT if possible.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Infrastructure Security, Orion Health
[Attachment: orion_export_schema_v1.csv (CSV, 3 KB)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orionhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: RFI: Audit logs — transport encryption, tamper evidence, bulk extract options

Samir —

Thanks for the clear list. High-level responses below; Marissa (security & infra) and Ben (ops) are copied and will add specifics. We can also run a quick 30-min sync to go through the export artifact if helpful.

1) In-transit encryption: All control plane and export deliveries use TLS 1.2+ with modern ciphers. We also support mTLS for push deliveries into customer-managed endpoints (S3 with client certs or HTTPS endpoints). We can provide cipher suites and ATO evidence on request.

2) At-rest encryption: Export bundles written to Redwood-managed storage are encrypted with AES-256. For Dedicated/Private customers we support customer-managed keys via KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) or HSM-backed keys for on-prem deployments.

3) Tamper evidence: Export bundles are produced with a manifest file that includes SHA-256 hashes for each artifact and a top-level bundle hash. For customers requiring notarization we can optionally sign manifests with a timestamped key and provide a hash manifest for chain-of-custody.

4) Delivery patterns: We support push to S3 (preferred), presigned URL delivery, SFTP (SFTP server push), and streaming via Kafka for near-real-time forwarding. Max single-file size defaults to 50 GB; we use chunking for larger extracts.

5) Retention & snapshots: Retention controls are configurable per-tenant; snapshot exports (point-in-time full export) can be scheduled or on-demand. Typical turnaround SLA for an on-demand full audit export (up to 30 days of retention) is 48–72 hours; expedited exports available with commitment in SLA.

6) File schema: We reviewed your CSV. Our export includes event_id, event_type, actor_id, actor_email (if available), resource_id, resource_type, timestamp_utc (ISO8601), request_id, correlation_id, and payload_summary. We can map fields and provide a sandbox sample.

Attached: redwood_export_packaging_spec.pdf — contains manifest structure, chunking rules, and examples. Marissa / Ben: please add encryption/practical notes and commit on SLA language.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0112]
[Attachment: redwood_export_packaging_spec.pdf (PDF, 124 KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orionhealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: RE: RFI: Audit logs — transport encryption, tamper evidence, bulk extract options

Samir —

Adding technical detail from infra/engineering side. Bullet answers to your items:

- TLS & mTLS: We require TLS 1.2+; we recommend TLS 1.3 for improved latency. mTLS supported for S3 HTTPS endpoints via client certs or for HTTPS endpoints behind a customer proxy. We can provide example cert rotation procedures and cipher lists.

- KMS/HSM: For exports to your S3 bucket, you can set SSE-KMS with your CMK; Redwood will write objects with server-side encryption and the S3 put will include SSE headers. For Private deployments, keys can be kept in customer HSM and we support HSM-backed signing for manifests.

- Hashing & Signing: Each export bundle includes per-file SHA-256 and a manifest.json. If Orion requires notarization, we can perform a detached signature using an HSM-protected key and include a signed.timestamp (RFC3161) entry. Forensically, we retain a salted hash ledger for 90 days to support tamper investigation.

- Delivery throughput / chunking: Exports are chunked at 1 GB by default; we can increase chunk size on contract. For streaming exports we push JSON event records to your Kafka topic with at-least-once semantics and provide consumer offsets as metadata.

- Retention controls: Admins can set retention policies via the Console (per-route retention). We also expose a retrieval API to request point-in-time snapshots; snapshot generation SLA depends on size (we will commit in contract).

- Auditability evidence: We can supply a sample export package and a runbook describing the extraction process, signing, and verification commands suitable for your security team or third-party forensic lab.

I'll loop Laura (compliance) to start a DPA thread if Legal Ops needs that.

Marissa Cole
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_draft_sla_for_orion.pdf (PDF, 78 KB)]

From: Legal Ops <legal-ops@orionhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: RFI: Audit logs — transport encryption, tamper evidence, bulk extract options

Thanks — a few follow-ups from our side.

1) DPA: Please route a DPA (we have a baseline DPA with a handful of redlines). We need to ensure retained export bundles are covered and that forensic copies are subject to the same controls.

2) Chain-of-custody: Can you confirm whether Redwood keeps an immutable ledger of exported bundle hashes beyond the 90-day salted-hash ledger Marissa mentioned? Our compliance group prefers 1 year of provenance evidence for high-sensitivity extracts.

3) HSM-backed signing: If Redwood supports HSM-signed manifests, we need the signing certificate fingerprint and a brief key rotation policy.

4) Delivery audit trail: For S3 push and presigned URL deliveries, we require a delivery audit record (timestamp, delivery method, object names, SHA-256) as metadata in the manifest.

Please respond with specifics and any constraints by EOD Thursday PT so we can keep the procurement timeline.

Regards,
Legal Ops (on behalf of Samir)
Orion Health

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orionhealth.com>, Legal-ops <legal-ops@orionhealth.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: RFI: Audit logs — transport encryption, tamper evidence, bulk extract options

Samir / Legal Ops —

Appreciate the thorough questions. Quick answers and next steps below, and attached is a proposal SLA and an example export package you can validate.

- DPA/DOCS: Laura will send a DPA redline tracker today. We are comfortable including export bundles under DPA controls.

- Provenance retention: We store a salted, append-only hash ledger for 12 months for customers who opt into the evidence-retention add-on. Ledger entries include bundle hash, timestamp, job_id, and delivery target. This add-on can be contracted for regulated customers.

- HSM signing: Yes — we support HSM-backed detached signatures. Fingerprint of the current signing cert: SHA256:AB:3C:5D:... (will provide full fingerprint in DPA appendix). Key rotation policy: rotate every 90 days, with archival of previous keys for verification for 12 months.

- Delivery audit record: Manifests include the per-object SHA-256, delivery method, push timestamp, and aws_s3_object_key when applicable. Presigned URL deliveries include a delivery receipt that the consumer must acknowledge; we record that receipt in the job metadata.

Next steps: 1) Laura will send DPA redline; 2) Jordan to schedule 30-min technical walkthrough with your infra and forensic lab (cc'd Eve) to validate the sample export package; 3) we will attach the evidence-retention add-on pricing to the contract.

Attachment: redwood_export_packaging_spec.pdf (sample), redwood_draft_sla_for_orion.pdf (proposal)

Regards,
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
